types.review: All Native fields/defaults/order retained; HostSpace stat-double accumulation and core-kind metadata arrays; Native source/output grid UDT retained. StatsInitOptions bundles Native optionals without changing presence. C++ owner metadata is explicit and not process/model global.

adaptations: Column/level arguments are zero-based C++; model itime and internal registry/cache IDs/cursors remain Native one-based.

Generic rank1/rank2 executable bodies live in header templates to preserve arbitrary const/strided/device View types until the Native host-update boundary; C++ generic dispatch overloads do no additional arithmetic.

Kokkos View assignment aliases, so stats_var assignment and snapshot copies explicitly deep-copy all allocatable arrays; stats_type ordinary copying is prohibited to prevent duplicate file ownership. Snapshots borrow numeric file IDs but cannot mutate or close owners.
Native process-SAVE registry overflow warning becomes context-owned, persists across reset/reinitialize, and warns once/context rather than once/process; data truncation/deduplication is unchanged.
Native OpenMP critical region is unnecessary for current sequential standalone host-call path. Concurrent host statistics I/O is not supported; no global mutex introduced.
Native fixed strings use bounded std::string assignments in registry owner and normalized lookup; output list-directed diagnostic whitespace is language-specific.
Native WHERE/array expressions translate to host column-first loops with identical pointwise arithmetic; no cross-point reductions except integer max diagnostics.
RAII destructor closes partial owned contexts if explicit finalize is skipped; explicit finalize remains caller-visible error-reporting API.
